tool_args.rationale: The observed signatures and recalled mechanism specify a four-parameter barrier-activated flux with sink-gradient inhibition. The sink-gradient range is broad, satisfying the stated condition for deferring the open-branch probe. Fit all four parameters numerically to the five paid rows and use the fitted law for fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The supplied mechanism note requires this only when the s_grad span is below 0.08; observed span is 2.0, so this probe is not justified.
It does not use the observed sink-gradient variation, while the supplied signature includes sink_gradient_C2 and the barrier-siphon form directly accounts for it.
It lacks the barrier activation and sink-gradient inhibition indicated by the pilot signatures.
No trajectory or coupled ODE evidence is present; a direct parametric fit is less costly.
